text: The project emphasizes early warning-to-early action by integrating hydrometeorological infrastructure with anticipatory protocols and local planning. It includes a gender-transformative design, ensuring that women and persons with disabilities have prioritized access to information and services. The project is embedded within the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa disaster risk management frameworks, enhancing institutional ownership and sustainability. It also engages the private sector and local entrepreneurs to innovate and sustain climate services and adaptation solutions.

metadata.solution_name: SAP039: Integrated Climate Risk Management for Strengthened Resilience to Climate Change in Buner and Shangla Districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan
